result.reason: The operative language gives Licensee a 30-day written termination-for-convenience right and requires a refund of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period, functionally providing the required pro-rata refund. Licensor receives no convenience-termination right. However, the redline unnecessarily changes the separate breach-termination standard by adding materiality, notice, and a 30-day cure period, materially altering unrelated rights. It also leaves an internal inconsistency by referring to “such immediate termination” after immediate termination was removed, and “in whole or in part” is not clearly implemented.
